source: 757 Harvest Priest
target: 757 Sacerdos Messis

source: As Penitent Baynfel and the pure silver skull appeared, the doll messenger, dressed in a pale gold mini dress, instantly floated beside Lumian as if confronting the other two messengers.
target: Cum Penitent Baynfel et cranium argenti puri apparuerunt, nuntia pupula, induta parva veste aurea pallida, statim iuxta Lumian volavit, quasi ceteros duos nuntios opponens.

source: The pure silver skull set down a burlap bag on the desk from its mouth amidst the surrounding darkness, then fixed its burning pale eyes on Lumian.
target: Cranium argenti puri, ex ore suo, sacculum linteum in mensa inter circumiectas tenebras posuit et deinde oculos ardentes pallidos in Lumian fixit.

source: Penitent Baynfel dropped a folded letter and silently returned to the spirit world, vanishing from the room.
target: Penitent Baynfel epistolam plicatam deiecit et tacite ad mundum spirituum rediit, e conclavi evanescens.

source: Lumian wanted to take this opportunity to chat with his messenger about his past and ask about his relationship with the True Creator, but given the circumstances, he had to suppress his curiosity and focus on the pure silver skull instead.
target: Lumian hanc occasionem capere volebat, ut cum nuntio suo de praeteritis colloqueretur et de sua relatione cum Verace Creatore rogaret; sed ob circumstantias curiositatem suam reprimere oportuit et in cranium argenti puri impendere.

source: Lumian picked up the burlap bag, which resembled a book bag, and pulled out an aluminum flask.
target: Lumian sacculum linteum, quod saccum librorum simile apparebat, levavit et amphoram aluminii extraxit.

source: Behind him, the doll messenger floated closer, curiously looking on.
target: Post eum, nuntia pupula propius volavit, curiosa spectans.

source: Lumian unscrewed the grayish‐white flask to find a golden liquid inside, brimming with white foam.
target: Lumian amphoram cinereo–albida aperuit ut liquidum aureum intus inveniret, spumante albo abundans.

source: If it weren’t for the lack of a malty scent, he would have thought it was beer.
target: Nisi malti odor aberat, putavisset eam cerevisiam esse.

source: He took out a piece of paper from the burlap bag, written in ancient Feysac by Madame Hela: “It is indeed the Harvest Priest potion.
target: E sacculo linteo chartam extraxit, in antiqua Feysac a Madame Hela scriptam: “Vere est potio Sacerdotis Messis.

source: “It needs to be drunk within 15 minutes, or you will end up with a alcohol flask that could bring harvests.”
target: In quindecim minutis bibenda est, alioquin eris cum amphora alcoholica, quae messes afferre possit.

source: Seeing that Madame Hela had helped with the identification and there was a notarized contract in place, Lumian immediately took out the remaining 9000 gold risot from his Traveler’s Bag and the 1000 gold risot notes he had exchanged in the last two days.
target: Videns quod Madame Hela identificationi adfuerat et pactum notariatum exstabat, Lumian statim reliquos 9000 risotos aureos ex Sacculo Viatoris sui ac notae de 1000 risotos aureos, quas per proximos duos dies permutaverat, extraxit.

source: “This is the final payment.”
target: "Hoc est solutio finalis."

source: Lumian put the gold risot into the burlap bag and handed it to the skull made of pure silver.
target: Lumian risotos aureos in sacculum linteum posuit et illos cranio argenti puri tradidit.

source: The pure silver skull bit down on the burlap bag, merged with the surrounding darkness, and disappeared in an instant.
target: Cranium argenti puri in sacculo linteo mordens, cum circumiectis tenebris commiscutum, momento evanuit.

source: Lumian then turned his head and said with a smile to the doll messenger, “What’s your take?”
target: Tum Lumian caput convertit et, cum risu, nuntiā pupulā dīxit: “Quid censes?”

source: The doll messenger snorted.
target: Nuntia pupula sputavit.

source: “I will surpass them eventually!
target: “Eos tandem superabo!”

source: “I will become the first, no, the second most powerful messenger in this world!”
target: “Ego primus, immo secundus, nuntius potentissimus in hoc orbe fiam!”

source: “Quite ambitious,” Lumian replied, half-seriously, half in jest.
target: “Valde ambitiosum,” respondit Lumian, semiserio atque semiludente.

source: He wasn’t surprised by the doll messenger’s response; he already knew about the special nature of Penitent Baynfel and the pure silver skull.
target: Non miratus est responsum nuntiāe pupulae; iam noverat de natura speciali Penitent Baynfel et cranii argenti puri.

source: The doll messenger then hurled a dark, translucent orb, resembling a crystal ball but more ethereal, towards Lumian, who easily caught it.
target: Deinde nuntia pupula globum obscurum et translucidum, globum crystallinum similem sed magis aetherium, in Lumian iaculatus est, qui facile apprehendit.

source: Inside the bent, transparent barrier, a glossy black bone ring floated, its surface carved with the twisted, agonizing face of a demon, whose eyes contained two vague shadows.
target: Intra flexum, transparentem vallum, anulus ossis nigri lucidi fluitabat, cuius superficiem facies daemonis contorta et laboriosa incisa erat, cuos oculi duo umbrae vagi complebantur.

source: After letting the folded letter fall to the surface of the desk, the doll messenger also left Lumian’s room.
target: Postquam epistola plicata in superficiem mensae cecidit, nuntia pupula etiam conclave Lumiani reliquit.

source: It is indeed a Sealed Artifact made from Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristics… Lumian couldn’t afford to check the artifact’s effects and impacts right away, so he stored the dark transparent orb and the folded letter first, and then began to read the letter brought by his messenger.
target: Revera, hoc est artefactum sigillatum ex qualitatibus Beyonder Hisoka factum… Lumian effectus et ictus artefacti statim inspicere non potuit, itaque globum obscurum translucidum et epistolam plicatam primum condidit, deinde incipiebat legendum epistolam a nuntio suo adlatam.

source: The letter was very brief: “Seven of Wands: “Do you still remember your promise? We now need your help.
target: Epistola brevissima erat: “Septem Baculi: Num adhuc promissionem tuam meministi? Nunc auxilio tuo indigemus?

source: “If you don’t have other important matters recently, please meet us at the following coordinates, where I will tell you the details.”
target: “Si alias res magni momenti nuper non habes, quaeso, conveni nobiscum in locum consignatum, ubi tibi singula exponam.”

source: “Knight of Swords.”
target: “Eques Gladii.”

source: Knight of Swords needs help… Lumian came to a realization.
target: Eques Gladii auxilio indiget… Lumian hoc intellexit.

source: In the incident of the sea prayer ritual, he had asked this Minor Arcana card holder, working under Ma‘am Hermit, for help.
target: In casu rituum orationis maritimae, hunc tenorem chartae Minor Arcanae, sub Domina Hermit operantem, auxilium petivit.

source: At the time, he did not ask for a payment but mentioned that he might need a bit of help if he went to the Southern Continent, to which he readily agreed.
target: Tunc pecuniam non petivit, sed indicavit se parum auxilio indigens fore, si ad Continens Meridionalis perveniret, ad quod facile consensit.

source: Fortunately, I’m relatively free lately. Lumian put away the letter from the Knight of Swords, screwed the cap back on the grayish-white flask, and walked out of the room with it in hand.
target: Fortunate, nuper satis liber erat. Lumian epistolam a Eques Gladii receptam deponit, operculum super amphoram cinereo–albidem iterum adfixit, et e conclavi eam manu tenens egrediebatur.

source: Lugano was cleaning up the plates and cutlery that Ludwig had left behind.
target: Lugano patinas et instrumenta, quae Ludwig reliquit, purgabat.

source: “Your Harvest Priest potion has arrived,” Lumian stated calmly.
target: “Potio Sacerdotis Messis tua advenit,” inquit Lumian tranquille.

source: Lugano froze, a look of confusion washing over his face.
target: Lugano stetit, vultu confusione afflato.

source: After a few seconds, he pointed to the flask in his employer’s hand and asked, “This?”
target: Post paucos secundos, ad amphoram in manu domini sui indicavit et rogavit: “Hoc?”

source: “Yes, it looks more drinkable than the potions from the Hunter pathway,” Lumian chuckled as he shook the flask. “You have ten minutes to decide whether you want to drink it.”
target: “Ita, potabilius videtur quam potiones viae Venatoris,” inquit Lumian subridens, dum amphoram concutiebat. “Decem minuta habes ut decernas num eam bibas.”

source: “Ten minutes?” Lugano exclaimed, startled.
target: “Decem minuta?” exclamavit Lugano, perterritus.

source: Lumian nodded.
target: Lumian annuit.

source: “No, eight minutes.
target: “Non, octo minuta.

source: “If you haven’t made up your mind in eight minutes, I’ll find a stray dog downstairs or catch a rat and feed it this potion.”
target: “Si in octo minutis animum non constitueris, canem vagum deorsum inveniam aut rattum capiam et illi potionem impingam.”

source: “Don’t I need to prepare mentally and physically?” Fear was written all over Lugano’s face.
target: “Nonne opus est mihi praeparatio mentis atque corporis?” Timor in vultu Lugani apparuit.

source: This seems too casual, doesn’t it?
target: Hoc nimis leviter videtur, nonne?

source: This is a potion, after all!
target: Potio est, postremo!

source: If his mental and physical state weren’t right, he could either turn into a monster or die on the spot!
target: Si status mentis atque corporis eius non rectus esset, vel in monstrum verti posset vel statim morire.

source: “Only seven minutes left now,” Lumian reminded with a smile. “Your condition is fine; you just need to relax and remember that you are Ludwig’s nanny and family doctor.”
target: “Nunc tantum septem minuta restant,” inquit Lumian cum risu. “Status tuus rectus est; solum oportet te relaxare et meminisse te esse nutrice Ludwig et medicum familiaris.”

source: “Is that really okay?” Lugano still couldn’t believe it.
target: “Num ita revera licet?” Lugano adhuc id credere non potuit.

source: “Six minutes,” Lumian said coldly.
target: “Sex minuta,” inquit Lumian frigide.

source: “..” Lugano was stunned.
target: “…” Lugano attonitus erat.

source: How could time pass so quickly?
target: Quomodo tempus tam celeriter transire potuit?

source: Gritting his teeth, he replied, “Alright! But I need to drink it in Underground Trier.”
target: Dentes strinxit et respondit: “Recte! Sed id in Trier Subterraneo bibere mihi oportet.”

source: “Hmm?” Lumian raised an eyebrow.
target: “Hmm?” Lumian supercilium elevavit.

source: Lugano quickly explained, “I feel that standing on the earth helps me maintain my state while drinking the potion.”
target: Lugano celeriter explicavit: “Sento quod in terra stans mihi auxilium ferre permittit ut statum meum teneam dum potionem bibo.”

source: “The Earth pathway, huh…” Carrying the grayish-white flask, Lumian turned and walked out of the room.
target: “Iter Terrae, hm…” portans amphoram cinereo–albidem, Lumian se vertit et e conclavi abiit.

source: Lugano followed, pulling out a bunch of banknotes from his pocket.
target: Lugano secutus est, et ex sinu copiam chartarum argentariarum extraxit.

source: “This is all my savings, 15,000 verl d’or.
target: “Haec sunt omnia pecuniae meae, 15,000 verl d’or.

source: “You said before, the rest would be covered by you.”
target: “Tu ante dixisti reliqua a te soluta fore.”

source: Lumian nodded nonchalantly and accepted the 15,000 verl d’or without hesitation.
target: Lumian non curans annuit et 15,000 verl d’or sine mora accepit.

source: He still had 86,000 verl d’or, including a few coins and gold bars.
target: Adhuc 86,000 verl d’or habebat, inter quos nonnulli nummi et laminae aureae erant.

source: Once on the street, Lumian headed directly to the nearest entrance to Underground Trier.
target: Cum in platea esset, Lumian statim ad proximam introitum Trier Subterranei profectus est.

source: A stray dog passed by, barking as if to threaten them.
target: Canis vagus transibat, latrans quasi eos minaretur.

source: Lumian chuckled and “tested” Lugano, “Can you understand what it’s saying?”
target: Lumian subridens et Lugano “probavit” dicens: “Potesne intellegere quid dicat?”

source: With his mind full of thoughts about the Harvest Priest potion, Lugano asked in astonishment, “Y-you can understand? Do you have a mystical item from a Beast Tamer?”
target: Mentem plenam rerum de potione Sacerdotis Messis habens, Lugano stupens rogavit: “P–potesne intellegere? Habesne rem mysticam a Domitore Bestiarum?”

source: Lumian laughed to himself. “It says, ‘I heard you’re going to feed me a portion of the Harvest Priest potion; why haven’t you given it to me yet?’”
target: Lumian sibi interius risit: “Dicit: ‘Audivi te portionem potionis Sacerdotis Messis mihi adferre; cur eam mihi nondum tradidisti?’”

source: “..” Lugano then realized his employer was joking.
target: “…” Tum Lugano intellexit dominum suum iocari.

source: On second thought, Lugano felt like he was being mocked by his employer.
target: Postera cogitans, Lugano sensit se a domino suo derisum esse.

source: He’s implying that I’m a stray dog!
target: Implicat me esse canem vagum!

source: I was indeed wondering why he hasn’t given me the Harvest Priest potion yet…
target: Vere mirababar cur adhuc potionem Sacerdotis Messis mihi non dederit…

source: Once in Underground Trier, Lumian expertly navigated to a deserted tunnel and tossed the grayish-white flask at Lugano.
target: Cum in Trier Subterraneo esset, Lumian peritus ad tuniculum desertum profectus est et amphoram cinereo–albidem ad Lugano iecit.

source: As Lugano fumbled to catch the flask, Lumian coldly reminded, “Two minutes left.”
target: Dum Lugano amphoram apprehendere conabatur, Lumian frigide admonuit: “Duo minuta restant.”

source: Lugano took a deep breath, unscrewed the cap, and saw the potion inside that looked like beer.
target: Lugano altum spiritum traxit, operculum deprimens, et potionem intus vidit, quae cerevisiam similis erat.

source: He began to recall how he had cared for and treated Ludwig, using this memory to slightly relax his tense spirit.
target: Coepit recordari quomodo Ludwig curaverat, hanc memoriam ad levandam animum suum tensum adhibens.

source: After a few seconds and two deep breaths, Lugano raised the grayish-white flask and gulped down the potion.
target: Post paucos secundos et duas profundae spiratus, Lugano amphoram cinereo–albidem elevavit et potionem ingurgitavit.

source: Lumian, who made a ball of bright white flame as a light source, silently watched, observing the various changes in Lugano’s body.
target: Lumian, qui globum flammae albae nitidae ut lucis fons confecit, silentiose spectabat, varias mutationes in corpore Lugani observans.

source: He had not forgotten that his “servant” was quite unusual; he could stay conscious during the Dream Festival!
target: Non oblitus erat quod “servus” eius valde insolitus esset; poterat in Festa Somniorum conscire manere!

source: Lugano’s face quickly twisted in agony, as if experiencing the pain of Ludwig biting off his arm again.
target: Facies Lugani celeriter in dolore contorta est, quasi iterum dolorem, quem Ludwig in brachio suo mordendo afferebat, experiri posset.

source: Lumian saw his feet slowly sinking into the soil, the hairs on his exposed skin visibly thickening and lengthening, and his brown hair doing the same, his brown eyes losing focus.
target: Lumian vidit pedes eius lente in terram mergi, pilos in cute patefacta manifeste densari et longari, et capillos fuscos idem agere, oculosque fuscos sensu confusione amittere.

source: After a while, the transformations stopped, and Lugano’s expression gradually eased.
target: Post aliquod tempus, transformationes cessaverunt, et vultus Lugani paulatim lenitus est.

source: It went smoothly… He fits the Planter pathway well… I’m not sure if this is due to his own anomalies… Lumian muttered silently, watching as Lugano’s eyes slowly regained clarity and reason.
target: Leniter procedebat… Iter Plantatoris eum optime convenit… Nescio utrum his ipsius singularitatibus sit… Lumian tacite submurmuravit, dum oculi Lugani lente claritatem atque rationem recipere videbantur.

source: He asked in a relaxed posture, “What abilities have you gained?”
target: In statu relaxato rogavit: “Quas facultates acquisivisti?”

source: Although it was frowned upon in the mystical world to inquire about the details of someone’s Beyonder abilities, who could be blamed because the person across from him was his “servant”?
target: Quamquam in mundo mystico fastidiebatur de subtilitatibus facultatum Beyonder alicuius inquisire, quis enim reicere posset, cum persona adversa esset eius “servus”?

source: Lugano saw no problem with this, checking his condition while savoring the acquired mystical knowledge.
target: Lugano in hoc nullum problema invenit, statum suum perscrutans et sapientiam mysticam adeptam degustans.

source: “My healing capabilities have expanded. I can now cure diseases in plants and fields…
target: “Facultates curandi meae ampliatae sunt. Nunc morbos in plantis et agris sanare possum…

source: I can also catalyze seeds, making them grow or reproduce faster.
target: Etiam semina accelerare possum, ita ut celerius crescant vel reproduci queant.

source: This divides into two scenarios: the first is placing both hands on the earth, which allows seeds and plants within a thirty‐meter radius to grow or reproduce much faster than normal, though not instantaneously complete their lifecycle from gestation to returning to the land in a few seconds or minutes. The second is directly holding some seeds or plants and fully catalyzing the life contained within them.
target: Hoc in duas casus dividitur: prima, utras manus in terram ponendo, quae sinit semina et plantas intra spatium triginta metrorum celerius quam solito crescere vel reproducere (non tamen statim totum eorum vitae cyclum a genesis ad terram reditionem perficere); secunda, semina vel plantas directe tenendo et vitam intus plenarie accelerando.

source: “The latter scenario allows me, in a very short time, to create a large amount of vines, which can be used to entangle and control enemies.”
target: “Secunda casus mihi sinit, brevissimo tempore, multas vitis creare, quae hostes implicare et regere adhiberi possint.”

source: Hearing this, Lumian thoughtfully asked, “So you can only fully catalyze the life contained within plants, and it can’t be used on humans?”
target: Hoc audito, Lumian cogitans rogavit: “Ita solum vitam in plantis contentam plene accelerare potes, et non in hominibus adhiberi potest?”

source: “No.” Lugano shook his head.
target: “Non,” inquit Lugano, caput concussit.

source: Lumian continued, “If you encounter a creature that is essentially a plant but has intelligence, could you, by direct contact, cause all of its life to burst forth in seconds or tens of seconds, completing its entire life cycle?”
target: Lumian continua: “Si invenias creaturam, quae maxime planta sit sed intelligentiam habeat, potesne, per contactum directum, totam eius vitam in paucis aut decem secundis erumpere, totumque vitae cyclum perficere?”

source: “First, I’d need to be able to touch it…” Lugano indicated that this was dangerous and not something he, not specialized in combat, could manage.
target: “Primum, attingi illud mihi posse necesse est…” Lugano significavit hoc periculosum esse atque rem, quam ipse, non pugnandi artibus instructus, tractare non possentem.

source: He added, “Plus, I’m not sure it would have the effect you’re imagining.”
target: Adiecit: “Praeterea, non certo scio se effectum tibi concipiendum habere.”

source: Lumian nodded almost imperceptibly, signaling Lugano to continue.
target: Lumian fere imperceptibiliter annuit, indicans Lugano ut prosequeretur.

source: Lugano gathered his thoughts and said, “If I could obtain seeds of different mutant plants, my catalytic abilities could play a significant role in combat.
target: Lugano cogitationes suas colligens dixerit: “Si semina plantarum mutantarum diversarum adipisci possem, facultates accelerationis meae partes maximas in pugna agere possent.

source: “I can also command plants and insects within a thirty‐meter radius to provide me with appropriate support, as long as it does not exceed their species limitations. However, intelligent ones won’t work.
target: “Etiam plantas et insecta intra spatium triginta metrorum imperare possum, ut mihi subsidium idoneum praebeant, dummodo fines speciei eorum non excedantur; sed quae intelligentiam habent non sufficiunt.

source: “I’ve also gained a few ritual spells, mainly for summoning rain or clearing the skies.”
target: “Etiam nonnullas incantationes rituales accepi, praecipue ad pluviam evocandam aut caeli purgationem.”
